questions.question:
Two different positions of the same dice are shown below, the six faces of which are numbered 1 to 6. Find the number on the face opposite to the one having 2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a06f2828d984f9a7077dd287d0f7847da30926d9dd029d2bedf42503bd5febf5.png]
questions.solution:
The faces with numbers 1 and 5 are adjacent to the face with number 4 in the first position.

The faces with numbers 3 and 6 are adjacent to the face with number 4 in the second position.

The only number left is 2. i.e. 2 and 4 are on the opposite sides of the dice.

Hence, the number on the face opposite to the one having 2 is **4**.

questions.question: Given that NETWORK is represented by 16 and KEYBOARD is represented by 18, what would be the code for SOFTWARE?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0488b7c0daf98fa9fa0e852444d1bd45eb81cb2e556cd44c4fcac08bf72271ed.png] 

The logic followed here is,

NETWORK is represented by 16

(Number of letter in 'NETWORK' + 1) × 2 → (7 + 1) × 2 = 8 × 2 ⇒ 16

And,

KEYBOARD is represented by 18

(Number of letter in 'KEYBOARD' + 1) × 2 → (8 + 1) × 2 = 9 × 2 ⇒ 18

Similarly,

SOFTWARE is represented by

(Number of letter in 'SOFTWARE' + 1) × 2 → (8 + 1) × 2 = 9 × 2 ⇒ 18

Hence, the correct answer is " Option 3".
